name: meeting-recorder
description: fn 키로 제어하는 고음질 회의 녹음기 프로토타입

scripts.build:fn: swiftc -O native/fn-listener.swift -o native/fn-listener && swiftc -O native/permissions.swift -o native/permissions
scripts.start: npm run build:fn && npm run build:ts && electron .
scripts.selftest: npm run build:fn && npm run build:ts && electron . --selftest
scripts.test:crash: npm run build:ts && electron scripts/dev/review-crash-check.js && electron scripts/dev/review-unify-check.js
scripts.mr: npm run build:ts --silent && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron lib/cli/bin.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/dev/check-handlers.js && electron scripts/dev/ui-test.js && electron scripts/dev/review-crash-check.js && electron scripts/dev/review-unify-check.js && npm run build:fn && electron-builder --mac dir && sh scripts/sign-app.sh "dist/mac-arm64/Meeting Recorder.app"
scripts.install-app: npm run dist && rm -rf "/Applications/Meeting Recorder.app" && cp -R "dist/mac-arm64/Meeting Recorder.app" /Applications/

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 회의와 메모를 녹음하기 위해 마이크를 사용합니다.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: 회의 상대방의 목소리를 녹음하기 위해 시스템 소리를 사용합니다.
